premises.text: Enterprise workers cannot do real work on personal tablets because needed apps sit behind firewalls and MDM locks down the whole device
premises.evidence_span: people working within traditional enterprises cannot get their work done today on those devices because the apps they need

premises.text: WorkSpot is a secured work container on the device that leaves the rest of the device personal, unlocking via existing auth
premises.evidence_span: the one place where IT manages and the rest of the device remains personal

premises.text: One-click access traverses live SSL VPN to corporate apps and documents with encrypted offline virtual file system and remote wipe of only WorkSpot
premises.evidence_span: We just did it in one click and seconds, traversing through a live SSL VPN

premises.text: IT deploys in minutes on existing security investments with integrations to major SSL VPN vendors covering most enterprise users
premises.evidence_span: No new boxes to install in the data center, and he's up and running in minutes

premises.text: Patent-pending mobile virtualization and activity data power Insights and Events apps for UX, problem detection, audit, and compliance
premises.evidence_span: We take that big data and we've created two big apps for IT, Insights and Events

premises.text: Access and control are free; revenue comes from charging for end-user activity data
premises.evidence_span: giving access and control for free. What we do is change the revenue equation to charge for end user activity data
